title: Active and queued model cards
responsibility: Distinguishes an observed active model from a pending or completed model-switch request.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.active
inputs.description: Required observed session or null. Null shows that the active selection is unknown; an observation supplies selection, client, idle state and time.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.request
inputs.description: Required switch request or null. Shows requested selection, status, queue time and reason when present.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.models
inputs.description: Required known models used to resolve a friendly model label, falling back to the model identifier.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.providers
inputs.description: Required provider-name lookup used in selection labels.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.locked
inputs.description: Required flag disabling cancellation while another operation locks the controls.

inputs.name: ProviderPickerCards.oncancel
inputs.description: Required callback invoked by the cancel action for a pending request.

outputs.name: ProviderPickerCards
outputs.description: Separate active-session and switch-request cards. A pending request has a cancel action; no request receives an explicit empty state. The cards do not perform the cancellation themselves.
